ambient_events: A taxi pulls up, lets somebody out with two bags and pulls away.
The canopy's speakers say the forecourt is for dropping off only.
Somebody runs for the doors with a boarding pass in their teeth.
description: A drop-off lane under the terminal's glass canopy, with a taxi rank, a row of steel benches and a sign that says NO WAITING in four languages. Departures is north, the parking garage west and Airport Road south.
name: Departures Forecourt
